component.name: EverQuest Loot Tracker
component.summary: Track EverQuest loot, splits, inventories, recipes, and sales

description.p: EverQuest Loot Tracker is a local-first desktop companion for tracking live loot, group shares, item values, character inventories, spells, recipes, merchant activity, and sale payouts.
It watches EverQuest log and export files, stores data locally in SQLite, and provides tools for coordinating loot splits across a roster.
